name: Feathers for Grazle
summary: Grazle continues to accept feathers you find. He says your deeds will be known among his kind.

sections.title: Grazle's Thanks
sections.body: Grazle says he will make your deeds known among his kind. He continues to accept any feathers you find for as long as necessary.

faq.answer: Grazle is the one who accepts the feathers and says he will make your deeds known among his kind.
Grazle accepts any feathers you find, and says he will keep accepting them for as long as necessary.
Grazle says he will make sure your deeds are known among his kind.

attribution: In-game quest text: Feathers for Grazle
